ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback, we appreciate having your valued business for so many years! We are sorry to hear you are not pleased with the performance of your new Spirit as you were with your past grills, but we are here to help!

Your grill should be able to reach the same high temperature we expect from all of our grills, at least 450 F. If your grill is not getting that hot, we would suggest double-checking your current water column pressure.  The gas pressure provided to the grill is of the utmost importance, it affects the performance of the burner tubes. 

With natural gas grills, the water column pressure must meet 7inches (.2526 psi) for our Spirit and Genesis models. No worries if this doesn't come across clearly, as qualified professionals, gas installers, or some utilities should be equipped with a manometer to confirm the testing procedure.

Here is a link we would like to provide for review:
https://www.weber.com/US/en/blog/burning-questions/why-wont-my-natural-gas-grill-get-hot/weber-29496.html

We would like to hear more about this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
